summary.text: Mike King is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 74 who has represented the district since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
King works in construction and owns King Enterprise Group.

paragraphs.text: Mike King's career experience includes working in construction and owning King Enterprise Group.
He succeeded Stephen Owens in the District 74 seat and took office on January 13, 2025.
He faces Michele Ediger in the general election.
